summary: An input that receives focus on mount, with a button that remounts it through a keyed block.
use: Dialogs, inline editors and search fields where the first field should take focus as soon as it appears.
spec: Input has `placeholder="Focused on mount"` and `aria-label="Autofocused input"`
`let key = $state(0)` drives `{#key key}` around the input
`<Button onclick={() => key++}>Remount input</Button>` remounts the input so focus is applied again
